verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop's own documentation lists the AT-SPI D-Bus XML interfaces, including org.a11y.atspi.Accessible and org.a11y.atspi.Action. These are a documented programmatic interface for inspecting and invoking actions on desktop UI elements, which is a direct but narrow route to driving the product through an API. The evidence is a single listing of interface names, with no description of scope, usage or a general-purpose automation API. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose desktop/system control API beyond accessibility, any description of what the interfaces can drive, authentication or stability guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
